source: Kenneth French Data Library + Open Source Asset Pricing (Chen & Zimmermann 2022)

anomalies.name: Market
anomalies.description: The equity risk premium — excess return of the market over the risk-free rate. The oldest and most fundamental factor, first formalized in the CAPM. Investors are compensated for bearing undiversifiable market risk.

anomalies.name: Size (SMB)
anomalies.description: Small-minus-big: small-cap stocks historically earned higher returns than large-caps. Documented by Banz (1981) using 1926–1975 data. The premium has largely disappeared after publication, consistent with the McLean-Pontiff (2016) decay hypothesis.

anomalies.name: Value (HML)
anomalies.description: High-minus-low book-to-market: value stocks (high B/M) outperformed growth stocks. Core to the Fama-French three-factor model. The premium has significantly weakened post-publication, particularly over 2007–2020, though debate continues about whether the anomaly is risk or mispricing.

anomalies.name: Momentum (Mom)
anomalies.description: Past 12-month winners continue to outperform past losers over the next 3–12 months. One of the most robust anomalies across asset classes and geographies, yet also the most crash-prone: the strategy lost ~50% during the 2009 reversal. The premium persists post-publication but at reduced magnitude.

anomalies.name: Profitability (RMW)
anomalies.description: Robust-minus-weak operating profitability: more profitable firms earn higher returns. The economic intuition aligns with both risk (profitable firms are harder to distress) and mispricing (investors underweight cash flow quality). Relatively recent publication; the post-publication sample is short.

anomalies.name: Investment (CMA)
anomalies.description: Conservative-minus-aggressive investment: firms that invest conservatively outperform aggressive investors. Related to the q-factor model (Hou, Xue & Zhang 2015). The premium is theoretically motivated by the investment-value relationship in production-based asset pricing models.

anomalies.name: Put volatility minus call volatility
anomalies.description: Using OptionMetrics's daily volatility surfaces (vsurfd), keep last observation each month, delta = 0.50 or -0.50, and days to expiration = 30.  The signal is then the difference between put implied vol and call implied vol.

anomalies.name: Predicted div yield next month
anomalies.description: Using CRSP distributions, keep only distcd beginning in 12 and if the third digit of distcd is 3, 4, or 5.  Also keep only if stock paid a dividend in the last 12 months.  Define Ediv1 = div 2 months ago if distcd's 3rd digit is 0, 1, or 3.  Define Ediv1 = div 5 months ago if the distcd 3rd digit is 4.  Define Ediv = div 11 months ago if the distcd 3rd digit is 5.  Define Edy1 as Ediv1/abs(prc).  Finally, discretize Edy1 to smooth around the huge mass at 0 as follows: DivYieldST = 0 if Edy1 = 0, 1 if Edy is between 0 and 0.005, 2 if Edy1 is between 0.005 and 0.010, and 3 if Edy > 0.010.

anomalies.name: Earnings announcement return
anomalies.description: Get announcement date for quarterly earnings from IBES (fpi = 6). AnnouncementReturn is the sum of (ret - mktrf + rf) from one day before an earnings announcement to 2 days after the announcement.

anomalies.name: Change in put vol minus change in call vol
anomalies.long_description: Change in put vol minus change in call vol
anomalies.description: Take difference of dVolCall and dVolPut

anomalies.name: Earnings surprise streak
anomalies.description: Use fpi == 6 and only the last statpers for each anndats_act.  Define surp = (actual - meanest)/price.  Define a firm-anndats as a streak if surp has the same sign as the most recent surp observation.  Keep only streaks.  Then define signal = surp.

anomalies.name: EPS forecast revision
anomalies.description: keep fpi == "1", last obs each month.  Signal is meanest / last month's meanest.

anomalies.name: Volume Trend
anomalies.description: Rolling coefficient from regressing monthly trading volume on a linear time trend over a window of 60 months (require that at least 30 exist). Scale coefficient by 60-month average of trading volume.

anomalies.name: Net Payout Yield
anomalies.description: Dividends (dvc) plus purchase of common and preferred stock (prstkc) minus sale of common and preferred stock (sstk), divided by market value of equity lagged 6 months.  Exclude if NetPayoutYield is 0, financial firm based on SIC code, ceq <= 0, or less than 2 years in CRSP

anomalies.name: Net external financing
anomalies.description: Sale of common stock (sstk) minus dividends (dv) minus purchase of common stock (prstkc) plus long-term debt issuance (dltis) minus long-term debt reductions (dltr). Scaled by total assets (at).

anomalies.name: Short Interest
anomalies.description: Short-interest from Compustat (shortint) scaled by shares outstanding (shrout). Short-interest data are available bi-weekly with a four day lag. We use the mid-month observation to make sure data would be available in real time.

anomalies.name: Call minus Put Vol
anomalies.description: ATM Call vol minus ATM put vol

anomalies.name: gross profits / total assets
anomalies.description: Revenue (sale) - cost of goods solds (cogs), divided by  total assets (at).  Drop if financial.

anomalies.name: Percent Total Accruals
anomalies.description: Net income (ni) minus (purchase of common and preferred stock (prstkcc) minus sale of common and preferred stock (sstk) plus dividends (dvt), cash flow from operations (oancf), from financing (fincf) and investment (ivncf)). Scaled by absolute value of net income.

anomalies.name: Change in Taxes
anomalies.description: 4-quarter change in quarterly total taxes (txtq), scaled by lagged total assets (at).

anomalies.name: Share issuance (5 year)
anomalies.description: 5-year growth in number of shares. Number of shares is calculated as shrout/cfacshr to adjust for splits.

anomalies.name: Active shareholders
anomalies.description: Institiutional ownership share (maxinstown\_perc) if share greater than 5 percent.  Set to missing if G is missing, or if dual share class, or if 24 minus Governance index (G) is less than 19.

anomalies.name: Dividend seasonality
anomalies.description: Drop if 3rd digit of distcd = 2 or >= 6.  Assign DivSeason = 0 if there was a dividend paid in the last 12 months.  Replace DivSeason = 1 if the third digit of disctcd is 3, 0, or 1, and a positive dividend was paid 2, 5, 8, or 11 months ago, if the third digit is 4 and a dividend was paid 5 or 11 months ago, or if the third digit is 5 and a dividiend was paid 11 months ago.

anomalies.name: Earnings Surprise
anomalies.description: EPS (epspxq) minus EPS twelve months ago - Drift, scaled by standard deviation of that expression. Drift is the average earnings growth (EPS - EPS twelve months ago) over the past two years. Exclude if price less than 5

anomalies.name: Return seasonality years 16 to 20
anomalies.description: Average return in the same month over the preceding 16-20 years.

anomalies.name: Share issuance (1 year)
anomalies.description: Growth in number of shares between t-18 and t-6. Number of shares is calculated as shrout/cfacshr to adjust for splits.

anomalies.name: Short term reversal
anomalies.description: Stock return (ret) over the previous month.

anomalies.name: Inst own among high short interest
anomalies.long_description: Inst own among high short interest
anomalies.description: Exclude all stocks with short interest (ShortInterest) below 99th percentile. IO\_ShortInterest is institutional ownership (instown\_perc).  Keep NYSE Only.

anomalies.name: Return on assets (qtrly)
anomalies.description: Quarterly net income (ibq) divided by lagged total assets (atq).

anomalies.name: Change in order backlog
anomalies.description: Define normalized order backlog  as order backlog (ob) divided by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t. Exclude if order backlog is 0.  Signal is normalized order backlog minus normalized order backlog one year ago.

anomalies.name: Net equity financing
anomalies.description: Sale of common stock (sstk) minus  purchase of common stock (prstkc), scaled by average total assets (at) from years t and t-1. Exclude if absolute value of ratio is greater than 1.

anomalies.name: Inst Own and Idio Vol
anomalies.description: Follow RIO\_MB, except define volatility as the rolling standard deviation of the last 12 months of the stock return.  Let RIO\_Disp = lagged RIO quintile if the Volatility quintile == 5

anomalies.name: Taxable income to income
anomalies.description: Ratio of Taxes paid and tax share of net income. Numerator is defined as the sum of foreign (txfo) and federal (txfed) income taxes. If either one is missing, numerator is defined as total taxes (txt) minus deferred taxes (txdi). Denominator is the product of the prevailing tax rate and net income (ib). Tax rate is .48 before 1979, .46 from 1979 to 1986, .4 in 1987, .34 between 1988 and 1992 and .35 from 1993 onwards. If net income is negative, and the numerator is positive, tax is defined as 1. Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Exchange Switch
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if a firm switched from AMEX or NASDAQ to NYSE within the past year, or from NASDAQ to AMEX within the past year.

anomalies.name: Net debt financing
anomalies.description: Long-term debt issuance (dltis) minus long-term debt reduction (dltr) minus current debt changes (dlcch), scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t. Replace missing values of dlcch with 0. Exclude if ratio is greater than 1.

anomalies.name: Operating Cash flows to price
anomalies.description: Operating cash-flow (oancf) divided by market value of equity. If operating cash-flow is missing, replace by difference betwee net income (ib) and level of accruals, where the latter is the annual change in current assets (act) minus the annual change in cash and short-term investments (che), minus the annual change in current liabilities (lct) plus the annual change in debt in current liabilities (dlc) plus the annual change in payable income taxes (txp) plus depreciation (dp).

anomalies.name: Revenue Surprise
anomalies.description: Define revenue per share as quarterly revenue (revtq) divided by quarterly common shares outstanding (cshprq). RevenueSurprise is the 4-quarter change in revenue per share minus the average 4-quarter change in revenue per share over the previous 2 years. RevenueSurprise is scaled by its standard deviation over the previous 2 years. Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Book to market using December ME
anomalies.long_description: Book to market using December ME
anomalies.description: BM using most recent December value of market equity.

anomalies.name: Down forecast EPS
anomalies.description: Keep fpi = 1.  Binary variable equal to 1 if mean analyst earnings forecast for the next quarter (meanest) has improved over the previous month, and 0 otherwise.

anomalies.name: Convertible debt indicator
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if deferred charges (dc) greater than 0 or common shares reserved for convertible debt (cshrc) greater than 0.
anomalies.journal_full: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

anomalies.name: Earnings streak length
anomalies.description: Number if consecutive 4-quarter increases in ibq, up to 8.

anomalies.name: Book-to-market and accruals
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if stock is in the highest Accrual quintile and the lowest BM quintile, and equal to 0 if stock is in the lowest Accrual quintile and the highest BM quintile. Exclude if book equity (ceq) is negative.
anomalies.journal_full: Review of Quantitative Finance and Accounting

anomalies.name: IPO and no R&D spending
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if R&D expense (xrd) = 0 and IndIPO = 1.  0 otherwise.

anomalies.name: Earnings forecast revisions
anomalies.description: Define revisions as the change in the mean earnings estimate (meanest) for the next quarter from month t-1 to t, scaled by stock price in month t-1. REV6 is the sum of that variable from months t-6 to t.

anomalies.name: Sales-to-price
anomalies.description: Ratio of annual sales (sale) to market value of equity.

anomalies.name: Change in recommendation
anomalies.description: keep last ireccd each month, then average across analysts for each firm-month.  Define opscore as 6-ireccd.  Signal is opscore - last month's opscore.

anomalies.name: Change in call vol
anomalies.description: Using OptionM vol surface, 30 day mat, delta = 0.5, find first diff of implied vol

anomalies.name: Up Forecast
anomalies.description: Keep fpi = 1.  Binary variable equal to 1 if mean earnings forecast (meanest) decreased over the past month.

anomalies.name: Asset growth
anomalies.description: Annual growth rate of total assets (at)

anomalies.name: Industry return of big firms
anomalies.description: Average monthly return (ret) of the 30% largest companies by market value of equity in the same Fama-French 48 industry. Exclude the largest 30% of companies for IndRetBig (not to compute the anomaly!)

anomalies.name: Earnings consistency
anomalies.description: Average earnings growth over previous 48 months. Earnings growth is defined as EPS (epspx) minus EPS 12 months ago divided by average EPS 12 and 24 months ago. Exclude if price less than 5, absolute value of 12 month earnings growth greater 600%, or earnings growth and earnings growth 12 months ago have different signs.

anomalies.name: Mohanram G-score
anomalies.description: See code for details.  MS is only evaluated for low BM firms and comes from combining three signals related to profitability and cash flow, two signals related to income volatility, and three signals related to investment.

anomalies.name: O Score
anomalies.description: OScore = -1.32 - .407*log(at/GNP deflator) + 6.03*(lt/at) - 1.43*( (act - lct)/at) + .076*(lct/act) - 1.72*I(lt > at) - 2.37*(ib/at) - 1.83*(fopt/lt) + .285*(ib + ib$_{t-12}$ + ib$_{t-24}$ < 0) -  .521*( (ib - ib$_{t-12}$)/(abs(ib) + .abs(ib$_{t-12}$)) ). fopt = oancf if fopt is missing.  Exclude Exclude if SIC code between 3999 and 4999, or greater than 5999. Exclude if price less than 5.  Then exclude if OScore is in bottom quintile of OScore (original paper shows non-monotonic returns, as does our replication)

anomalies.name: Dividend Omission
anomalies.description: Keep only distcd 2nd digit = 2 or 3.  Define firms as quarterly, semi-annual, or annual payers based on payment history.  Define a consistent payer as a firm that paid quarterly or semi-annual dividends for the past 18 months, or annual dividends for the past 2 years.  An omission is the first month where a consistent payer failed to pay a dividend over the past quarter/6-months/year.  Finally, DivOmit = 1 if there is an omission in the past 2 months and 0 otherwise

anomalies.name: Firm Age - Momentum
anomalies.description: 6 month return, restricted to the bottom quintile of the cross-sectional firm age distribution. Exclude if price less than 5 or firm younger than 12 months.

anomalies.name: Growth in book equity
anomalies.description: Ratio of book equity (ceq) to book equity in the previous year. Include only if book equity is positive this year and last year.

anomalies.name: operating profits / book equity
anomalies.description: Revenue (revt) minus cost (cogs) - administrative expenses (xsga) - interest expenses (xint), scaled by book value of equity (ceq). Exclude smallest size tercile.

anomalies.name: Operating profitability R&D adjusted
anomalies.description: Revenue (revt) minus cost (cogs) - (administrative expenses (xsga) - R&D expenses (xrd)), all divided by total assets (at) in year t. Replace all variables in the numerator with 0 if they are missing. Exclude if share code is greater 11, market value of equity, BM or total assets are missing, or if SIC code between 6000 and 6999.

anomalies.name: Composite debt issuance
anomalies.description: Log of long-term debt (dltt) plus debt in current liabilties (dlc) minus log of the same variable 5 years ago.

anomalies.name: Composite equity issuance
anomalies.description: 5 year growth rate of market value of equity minus 5 year stock return.

anomalies.name: Change in put vol
anomalies.description: Using OptionM vol surface, 30 day mat, delta = 0.5, find first diff of implied vol

anomalies.name: Inventory Growth
anomalies.description: Defate invt growth using gnp deflator.  Signal is deflated invt growth rate from fiscal year t to fiscal year t-1.  Drop if 1 digit sic code is 4 or 6, or if at or ppent <= 0

anomalies.name: Change in financial liabilities
anomalies.description: Difference in financial liabilities (sum of long-term debt (dltt), current liabilitites (dlc) and preferred stock (pstk)) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

anomalies.name: Efficient frontier index
anomalies.description: Frontier is the residual of a regression of log(BM) on log(book equity (ceq)), long-term debt (dltt) to assets (at), capital expenditures (capx) to revenue (sale), R&D expense (xrd) to revenue, advertising expense (xad) to revenue, property plant and equipment (ppent) to assets, EBIT (ebitda) to assets, and dummies for Fama-French's 48 industry definitions. Regression is updated each month with a rolling window of 60 months.
anomalies.journal_full: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

anomalies.name: Earnings surprise of big firms
anomalies.description: Average monthly value of EarningsSurprise (defined above) of the 30% largest companies by market value of equity in the same Fama-French 48 industry. Exclude the largest 30% of companies for EarnSupBig (not to compute the anomaly)

anomalies.name: Inventory Growth
anomalies.description: 12 month change in inventory (invt) divided by average total assets.

anomalies.name: Off season reversal years 6 to 10
anomalies.description: Average return in other months over the preceding 6-10 years.

anomalies.name: Return skewness
anomalies.description: Skewness of daily returns (ret) over previous month.

anomalies.name: Book to market, original (Stattman 1980)
anomalies.description: Log of tangible book equity (ceqt) over market equity matched at FYE

anomalies.name: Inst Own and Turnover
anomalies.description: Follow RIO\_MB, except define turnover as vol/shrout.  Let RIO\_Turnover = lagged RIO quintile if the Volatility quintile == 5

anomalies.name: change in ppe and inv/assets
anomalies.description: One-year change in property, plants and equipment (ppegt) plus one year change in inventory (invt), scaled by one-year lagged assets (at).

anomalies.name: IPO and age
anomalies.description: Age is  (current year -  founding year from Jay Ritter's dataset). Exclude if IndIPO == 0.

anomalies.name: Share repurchases
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if stock repurchase indicated in cash flow statement (prstkc > 0), and 0 if prstkc = 0.

anomalies.name: Momentum in high volume stocks
anomalies.description: Define momentum as Mom6m, and volume as the rolling average of the past 6 months of monthly turnover (minimum 5 months).  Independent sort stocks into 10 momentum ports and 3 volume ports. Keep if volume is in the top port, and assign signal = momentum port.  Drop if less than 2 years on CRSP.

anomalies.name: Earnings Forecast to price
anomalies.description: Median estimate for next year eps (fpi = 1) in March, divided by stock price from December.  Dec fiscal year ends only, keep only forecasts more than 90 days out.  Keep only below median analyst coverage each month.

anomalies.name: Analyst earnings per share
anomalies.description: Using IBES unadjusted forecasts, keep fpi == 1, signal is meanest.

anomalies.name: Momentum based on FF3 residuals
anomalies.description: Run a rolling regression over 36 months of excess return (retrf) on excess market return (mktrf), size and value factors (smb, hml) and compute idiosyncratic returns as the one-month lagged residual. ResidualMomentum is the rolling mean of the residual divided by the rolling standard deviation of the residual, both computed over the past 11 months.

anomalies.name: Momentum (6 month)
anomalies.description: Stock return between months t-6 and t-1

anomalies.name: net income / book equity
anomalies.description: Net income (ni) over book value of equity (ceq). Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Initial Public Offerings
anomalies.description: 1 if IPO in the past 6-36 months.  0 otherwise.  IPO dates are taken from Jay Ritter's IPO data available at: http://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/ritter/ipodata.htm.  Missing IPO dates imply IndIPO = 0

anomalies.name: Inst Own and Forecast Dispersion
anomalies.description: Follow RIO\_MB, except define Disp as the stdev of IBES forecasts where fpi == 1 divided by at, and sort on Disp instead of MB.  Finally, let RIO\_Disp = lagged RIO quntile if the Disp quintile >= 4.

anomalies.name: Volatility smirk near the money
anomalies.description: Using OptionMetrics data, among options with duration between 10 and 60 days, implied volatility of put option with moneyness closest to but above 1 minus implied volatility of call option with moneyness closest to but below 1.  Keep only volume > 0, implied vol between 0.03 and 2.0, price > 0.125, open interest > 0.
anomalies.journal_full: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

anomalies.name: Idiosyncratic skewness (3F model)
anomalies.description: Skewness of idiosyncratic returns computed as residuals from regression of daily excess returns (ret - rf) on Fama-French factors (mktrf, smb, hml) over the previous month. We require at least 15 non-missing observations.

anomalies.name: Industry Momentum
anomalies.description: Weighted average of firm-level 6 month buy-and-hold return. Average is taken over two digit industries each month and weights are based on market value of equity.

anomalies.name: Momentum without the seasonal part
anomalies.description: Average return in  other months over the previous year.

anomalies.name: Change in long-term investment
anomalies.description: Difference in investment and advances (ivao) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

anomalies.name: Total assets to market
anomalies.description: Total assets (at) divided by market value of equity.

anomalies.name: Customer momentum
anomalies.description: Based on firms' principals customers from Compustat Segment data as in Cohen and Frazzini.

anomalies.name: Percent Operating Accruals
anomalies.description: Income before extraordinary items (ib) minus net cash flow (oancf) divided by absolute value of ib. If oancf is missing, PctAcc is defined as ( (act - act$_{t-12}$) - (che - che$_{t-12}$) - (  (lct - lct$_{t-12}$) - (dlc - dlc$_{t-12}$) - (txp - txp$_{t-12}$) - dp ) )/abs(ib). In either case, if ib is equal to 0, divide by .01 instead. Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Advertising Expense
anomalies.description: Advertising expense (xad) over market value of equity (shrout*abs(prc))

anomalies.name: change in net operating assets
anomalies.description: 12-month growth in Net Operating Assets scaled by lagged total assets (at). Net Operating assets are operating assets minus operating liabilities. Operating assets are total assets (at) minus cash- and short-term investments (che), operating liabilities are total assets minus long-term debt (dltt), minority interest (mib), deferred charges (dlc), book equity (ceq) and preferred stock (pstk), all items (except at and ceq) replaced with 0 if missing.

anomalies.name: Change in capex (two years)
anomalies.description: Growth rate of capital expenditures (capx) relative to two years ago.   If capx is missing, replace with annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent).

anomalies.name: Cash-based operating profitability
anomalies.description: Revenue (revt) minus cost (cogs) - (administrative expenses (xsga) - R&D expenses (xrd))  minus annual change in receivables (rect), annual change in investment (invt) and annual change in prepaid expenses, plus annual change in current deferred revenue (drc), long-term deferred revenue (drlt), accounts payable (ap) and accrued expenses (xacc), all divided by total assets (at) in year t. Replace all variables in the numerator with 0 if they are missing. Exclude if share code is greater 11, market value of equity, BM or total assets are missing, or if SIC code between 6000 and 6999.

anomalies.name: Change in capital inv (ind adj)
anomalies.description: Growth in capital expenditure (capx) minus average growth in capital expenditure in the same industry (two-digit SIC). If capx is missing, capital expenditure is defined as the annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent). Capital expenditure growth is defined as the percentage growth of capx today relative to the average capx over the previous two years (.5*(capx$_{t-1}$ + capx$_{t-2}$), or as percentage growth relative to the previous year only if t-2 is missing.

anomalies.name: Return seasonality years 11 to 15
anomalies.description: Average return in the same month over the preceding 11-15 years.

anomalies.name: Intermediate Momentum
anomalies.description: Stock return between months t-12 and t-6

anomalies.name: Junk Stock Momentum
anomalies.description: Mom6m. Include only stocks with a credit rating (splticrm) of BBB or lower. Drop if missing credit rating or non-standard credit rating.

anomalies.name: Off season reversal years 16 to 20
anomalies.description: Average return in other months over the preceding 16-20 years.

anomalies.name: EPS Forecast Dispersion
anomalies.description: Keep fpi = 1 and fpedats > statpers + 30.  Standard deviation of earnings estimates (stdev\_est) scaled by mean earnings estimate.

anomalies.name: Past trading volume
anomalies.description: Log of two-month lagged trading volume (vol) times two-month lagged price (prc).

anomalies.name: Intangible return using CFtoP
anomalies.description: In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on the 5 year lagged  CFP = (net income (ni) plus depreciation (dp))/market value of equity and a constructed regressor that is the change in CFP from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanCFP.

anomalies.name: Analyst Recommendations and Short-Interest
anomalies.description: Go long firms in lowest quintile of short interest (shortint/shrout) and lowest quintile of analyst recommendations (monthly consensus recommendation using the most recent analyst recommendation in the past 12 months). Go short firms in highest quintile of short interest and highest quintile of analyst recommendations.

anomalies.name: Enterprise component of BM
anomalies.description: (ceq + che - dltt - dlc - dc - dvpa+ tstkp ) / (mve\_c + che - dltt - dlc - dc - dvpa+ tstkp). Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Breadth of ownership
anomalies.description: Quarterly change in the number of institutional owners (numinstowners) from 13F data. Exclude if in the lowest quintile of stocks by market value of equity (based on NYSE stocks only).

anomalies.name: Change in equity to assets
anomalies.description: Difference in book equity (ceq) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

anomalies.name: Coskewness using daily returns
anomalies.description: Signal is the sample counterpart of $E[\tilde{r}_{it} \tilde{r}_{mt}^2]/( SD[\tilde{r}_{it} ] SD[\tilde{r}_{mt}]^2$ where $\tilde{r}_{it}$ is the de-meaned stock return and $\tilde{r}_{mt}$ is the de-meaned market excess return.  Signal is computed using the past year of daily data, and using the NYSE CRSP VW index for the market (dsia), with returns continuously compounded.  See code for details.

anomalies.name: Change in Forecast and Accrual
anomalies.description: Within upper half of Accruals distribution, equal to 1 if mean earnings estimate increased relative to the previous month. 0 if it decreased.

anomalies.name: Conglomerate return
anomalies.description: Identify conglomerate firms as those with multiple OPSEG or BUSSEG entries in the Compustat segment data (and require that at least 80% of firm's total assets are covered by segment data). Compute monthly stock return at the 2-digit SIC level for stand-alone (non-conglomerate) firms only, and match those returns to conglomerates' segments. Compute weighted conglomerate return as the industry return of stand-alone companies, weighted with a conglomerate's total sales in each industry.

anomalies.name: Growth in advertising expenses
anomalies.description: Log of advertising expense (xad) minus log of advertising expense last year. Exclude if price less than 5, xad less than .1 or stock in the lowest decile of market value of equity.

anomalies.name: Intangible return using EP
anomalies.description: In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on the 5 year lagged  EP = net income (ni)/market value of equity and a constructed regressor that is the change in EP from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanEP.

anomalies.name: Medium-run reversal
anomalies.description: Stock return between months t-18 and t-13.

anomalies.name: Long-run reversal
anomalies.description: Stock return between months t-36 and t-13.

anomalies.name: Coskewness
anomalies.description: Signal is the sample counterpart of $E[\tilde{r}_{it} \tilde{r}_{mt}^2]/( SD[\tilde{r}_{it} ] SD[\tilde{r}_{mt}]^2$ where $\tilde{r}_{it}$ is the de-meaned stock excess return and $\tilde{r}_{mt}$ is the de-meaned market excess return.  Signal is computed using the past 60 months of monthly data, and using the NYSE/AMEX CRSP VW index for the market (msic).  See code for details.

anomalies.name: Organizational capital
anomalies.description: Defined recursively. Set xsga to 0 if missing.  Initialize with OrgCap = 4*general expenses (xsga) in the first year, and calculate as .85*OrgCap previous year + xsga/gnpdeflator current year thereafter. Scale by total assets (at).  Keep only december year ends, and non-financials, and non-missing sic code.  Then winsoriz at the 1% level and standardized by subtracting the same month within-industry mean (Fama French 17 industries) and dividing by the same month within industry standard deviation of OrgCap.

anomalies.name: Debt Issuance
anomalies.description: Equal to 1 if debt issuance (dltis) greater 0 and 0 otherwise. Exclude if share code > 11 or missing book-to-market.

anomalies.name: Volume to market equity
anomalies.description: Average monthly dollar trading volume (vol*abs(prc)) over the previous 12 months, scaled by market value of equity. Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Earnings-to-Price Ratio
anomalies.description: ib / lag(market value of equity, 6 months).  NYSE stocks only.  Exclude if EP < 0.  Lag simulates the Dec 31 market equity used in original paper

anomalies.name: Dividend Initiation
anomalies.description: Keep only distcd 2nd digit = 2 or 3.  Define dividend initiation as having paid a dividend in month t (divamt > 0), and not having paid a dividend in the last 24 months.  DivInit is equal to 1 if a dividend was initiated in the past 6 months, and 0 for all other stocks.

anomalies.name: Deferred Revenue
anomalies.description: Annual change in deferred revenue (drc) scaled by average total assets (at) in t-1 and t. Exclude if negative book equity (ceq), deferred revenue equal to 0 in both years, revenue less than 5m, or SIC code between 6000 and 6999.

anomalies.name: Piotroski F-score
anomalies.description: Sum of nine indicator variables which are: 1 if net income (ib) greater 0; 1 if net cash flow (oancf) greater 0; 1 if return on assets (ib/at) increased relative to previous year; 1 if net cash flow greater net income; 1 if long-term debt to assets (dltt/at) declined over the previous year;  if current assets to current liabilities (act/lct) increased over the previous year; 1 if ebit/sale (ebit = ib + txt + xint) increased over the previous year; 1 if revenue to assets increased over the previous year; 1 if shrout $\leq$ shrout last year. Include highest quintile of book-to-market only.  Exclude if missing any of the input variables.

anomalies.name: Cash flow to market
anomalies.description: Net income (ib) plus depreciation (dp) divided by market equity. Exclude NASDAQ stocks.

anomalies.name: Off season long-term reversal
anomalies.description: Average return in other months over the preceding 2-5 years.

anomalies.name: Credit Rating Downgrade
anomalies.description: A downgrade happens if credit rating (splticrm) decreased by at least one notch relative to the previous month.  CredRatDG = 1 if a downgrade happened over the past 3 months.  OP studies Moody's ratings changes between 1970 and 1997, but our data doesn't begin in earnest until 1986, and our sample definitions apply to returns, and this predictor implicitly averages over the past 6 months.

anomalies.name: Cash Productivity
anomalies.description: Calculate market value of equity (mve_c) as absolute price (prc) times number of shares outstanding (shrout). Cash productivity is equal to the difference between mve_c and total assets (at) divided by cash and short-term investments (che).

anomalies.name: Market leverage
anomalies.description: Total liabilities (lt) divided by market value of equity.

anomalies.name: Systematic volatility
anomalies.description: Coefficient on daily change in the VIX of a 1-month rolling window regression of daily stock excess returns on market return and the daily change in the CBOE S&P 100 volatility index (downloaded from FRED). Require at least 15 non-missing observations.

anomalies.name: R&D ability
anomalies.description: Regress log of sales growth (sale over sale in previous year) on log of (1+ xrd/sale) in 5 bivariate regressions with (1+xrd/sale) lagged by $1, \ldots, 5$ years. Run regressions over previous 8 years and require at least 6 non-missing observations. Also require at least half of past research and development observations to be non-zero. RDAbility is the mean of the coefficients on the five lags of log(1+xrd/sale). Set to missing if firm is not in the highest tercile of xrd/sale in a year or if reseach and development expenses are non-positive.

anomalies.name: Employment growth
anomalies.description: Change in number of employees (emp) between t -1 and t, scaled by average number of employees in t-1 and t. Replace hire with 0 if emp or lagged emp is missing.

anomalies.name: Probability of Informed Trading
anomalies.description: Download parameter estimates from the page for Duarte, Hu, Young, JFE 2020 https://edwinhu.github.io/pin/ and apply Easley et al's Equation 5.  Use Year t PIN estimates to forecast returns throughout Year t+1

anomalies.name: Change in current operating assets
anomalies.description: Difference in current operating assets (total current assets (act) minus cash and short-term investments (che)) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

anomalies.name: Enterprise Multiple
anomalies.description: Market value of equity + long-term debt (dltt) + debt in current liabilities (dlc) + deferred charges (dc) - cash and short-term investments (che) , divided by operating income (oibdp). Exclude if missing book equity or negative operating income.
anomalies.journal_full: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

anomalies.name: Analyst Value
anomalies.description: Value based on a three-stage dividend discount model and analyst forecasts, scaled by market value.  See code for details.

anomalies.name: Maximum return over month
anomalies.description: Maximum of daily returns (ret) over the previous month

anomalies.name: Payout Yield
anomalies.description: Sum of dividends (dvc), purchase of common and preferred stock (prstkc) and max(preferred stock redemption value (pstkrv), 0) over market value of equity lagged 6 months.  Exclude if PayoutYield $\leq$ 0, financial firm based on SIC code, ceq <= 0, or less than 2 years in CRSP

anomalies.name: Accruals
anomalies.description: Annual change in current total assets (act) minus annual change in cash and short-term investements (che) minus annual change in current liabilities (lct) minus annual change in debt in current liabilities (dlc) minus change in income taxes (txp). All divided by average total assets (at) over this year and last year. Exclude if abs(prc) < 5.

anomalies.name: Long-vs-short EPS forecasts
anomalies.description: Analyst forecasted 5-year earnings growth (fgr5yr) minus 100 times the difference between mean earnings forecast (meanest) and fiscal year earnings expectations (fy0a) scaled by the absolute value of fy0a.  Drop if fpedats is missing or fpedats - statpers < 30

anomalies.name: Decline in Analyst Coverage
anomalies.description: Using IBES forecasts, keep if fpi = 1, fpedats not missing, and fpedats > statpers + 30.  Binary variable equal to 1 if the number of analysts (numest) for next quarter's EPS estimate decreased relative to three months ago, and 0 if it increased.  Keep if in bottom two size quintiles among all firms to match OP's table.

anomalies.name: R&D over market cap
anomalies.description: R&D expense (xrd) over market value of equity.

anomalies.name: Option to stock volume
anomalies.description: Total monthly option volume (volume) over all puts and calls, divided by monthly stock trading volume (vol). Exclude if price less than 1 or share code greater 11 or option volume or stock volume data are missing for the previous month.

anomalies.name: Amihud's illiquidity
anomalies.description: Past twelve month average of: daily return (abs(ret)) divided by turnover((abs(prc)*vol)

anomalies.name: Idiosyncratic risk (3 factor)
anomalies.description: Standard deviation of residuals from Fama-French three factor regressions using the past month of daily data.  Value weighted

anomalies.name: Realized minus Implied Vol
anomalies.description: Realized Vol (past 30 days) minus ATM Implied Vol

anomalies.name: Trend Factor
anomalies.description: See paper section 2.1 and 2.2

anomalies.name: Days with zero trades
anomalies.description: In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Take 1-month average.

anomalies.name: Tail risk beta
anomalies.description: Each month, compute the 5th percentile over daily returns over all firms. For all daily return observations with return below that 5th percentile, compute the average of (log(ret/5th percentile of cross-sectional return distribution). Call that average tailEX. BetaTailRisk is the coefficient of a 120-month rolling regression of a firm's stock return on tailEX. Exclude if price less than 5 or share code greater than 11.

anomalies.name: Intangible return using Sale2P
anomalies.description: In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on 5 year lagged SP (defined above) and a constructed regressor that is the change in SP from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanSP.

anomalies.name: Days with zero trades
anomalies.description: In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Zerotrade is the 6-month average of that variable.

anomalies.name: 52 week high
anomalies.description: Price (prc/cfacshr) divided by the maximum price over the previous 12 months.

anomalies.name: Price
anomalies.description: Log of absolute value of price (prc).

anomalies.name: Return seasonality years 6 to 10
anomalies.description: Average return in the same month over the preceding 6-10 years.

anomalies.name: Intangible return using BM
anomalies.description: In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on 5 year lagged BM (defined above) and a constructed regressor that is the change in BM from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanBM.

anomalies.name: Change in capex (three years)
anomalies.description: Capital expenditures (capx) divided by the sum of capital expenditures from year - 1, year -2, and year -3.   If capx is missing, replace with annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent).

anomalies.name: Excluded Expenses
anomalies.description: Difference between unadjusted earnings (EPSActualUnadj) from IBES and quarterly earnings per share (epspiq). Exclude the highest and lowest 1% of values.

anomalies.name: Change in net financial assets
anomalies.description: Compute the sum of short-term investments (ivst) and investments and advances (ivao) minus the sum of long-term debt (dltt), debt in current liabilities (dlc) and preferred stock capital. Divide the difference between the current and one-year lagged sum by total assets (at) averaged over the current and previous fiscal years.

anomalies.name: Consensus Recommendation
anomalies.description: Binary variable if the monthly mean of recommendations (ireccd) over analysts is greater than 3, and 0 if it is less or equal than 1.5.

anomalies.name: Inst Own and Market to Book
anomalies.long_description: Inst Own and Market to Book
anomalies.description: Residual institutional ownership (RIO) is defined as log(institutional ownership (instown\_perc)/(1-institutional ownership)) + 23.6 - 2.89*log(market value of equity) +.08*log(market value of equity)$^2$. Replace instown\_perc with 0 if it is missing, with .9999 if it's above .9999, and with .0001 if it's below .0001. Then lag RIO by 6 months.  Keep only stocks with size > 20th percentile across exchcd == 1 or 2.  Define MB as market cap / (ceq + txditc), where txditc = 0 if missing, and MB is replaced with missing if ceq < 0.  Then sort into quintiles based on the lagged RIO, and sort into quintiles based on MB.  Finally, let RIO\_MB = lagged RIO quintile if the MB quintile = 5.

anomalies.name: Days with zero trades
anomalies.description: In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Take 12-month average.

anomalies.name: Change in current operating liabilities
anomalies.description: Difference in current operating liabilities (total current liabilities (lct) minus debt in current liabilities (dlc)) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

anomalies.name: CAPM beta
anomalies.description: Coefficient of a 60-month rolling window regression of monthly stock returns minus the riskfree rate on market return minus the risk free rate (ewretd - rf). Exclude if estimate based on less than 20 months of returns.

anomalies.name: Tangibility
anomalies.description: Cash and short-term investments (che) plus .715*receivables (rect) + .547*inventory (invt) + .535* property, plant and equipment (ppent), scaled by total assets (at). Only defined for manufacturing firms (SIC $\geq$ 2000 and SIC <4000). Exclude the lowest tercile of manufacturing firms by total assets.

anomalies.name: Net debt to price
anomalies.description: Long-term debt (dltt) plus debt in current liabilities (dlc) plus preferred stock (pstk) plus preferred dividends in arrears (dvpa) minus treasury stock (tstkp) minus cash and short-term investments (che), scaled by market value of equity. Exclude if SIC between 6000 and 6999, or if missing value for total assets (at), net income (ib), common shares outstanding (csho), book value of equity (ceq) or price close fiscal year (prcc\_f).  Keep only 3rd B/M Quintile, following Table 4 (and in contrast to Table 1).

anomalies.name: Real estate holdings
anomalies.description: Industry-adjusted value of real estate holdings. Real estate holdings are (fatb+fatl)/ppegt if available, and (ppenb+ppenl)/ppent otherwise.  Drop firms in 2 digit sics with < 5 firm or missing at or missing both ppent and ppegt. Subtract monthly industry-mean at the 2 digit SIC level.

anomalies.name: Change in Asset Turnover
anomalies.description: Annual change in AssetTurnover (defined above). Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Revenue Growth Rank
anomalies.description: Rank firms by their annual revenue growth each year over the past 5 years. MeanRankRevGrowth is the weighted average of ranks over the past 5 years, that is, MeanRankRevGrowth = (5*Rank$_{t-1}$ + 4*Rank$_{t-2}$ + 3*Rank$_{t-3}$ + 2*Rank$_{t-4}$ + 1*Rank$_{t-5}$)/15. Exclude NASDAQ stocks.

anomalies.name: Equity Duration
anomalies.description: see code

anomalies.name: Investment to revenue
anomalies.description: Ratio of capital investment (capx) to revenue (revt) divided by the firm-specific 36-month rolling mean of that ratio. Exclude if revenue less than \$10m.
anomalies.journal_full: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

anomalies.name: Customers momentum
anomalies.description: We download BEA Make-Use Tables, match to Compustat by NAICS assuming 5 year lag, compute returns within BEA 70 industries.  Then match each industry-year to matched-industry weights corresponding to IO tables as follows: for supplier mom, industry comes from cols of Use table, matched industries from the rows.  For customer mom: industry from rows of make table, matched industries from cols.  Weights exclude own-industry entries.  For each industry-month, average returns of matched industries, weighted using IO tables.  Sort industries into deciles based on matched returns, assign firm-months to industry deciles, Finally, long stocks in deciles 8-10 and short decile 1. Drop pre-1986 due to NAICS availability.

anomalies.name: Return seasonality last year
anomalies.description: Average return in the same monthin the previous year.

anomalies.name: Share Volume
anomalies.description: Let tempvol = sum of monthly share trading volume (vol) over the previous three months, scaled by 3 times common shares outstanding (shrout).  Let ShareVol = 1 if tempvol > 10%, and ShareVol = 0 if tempvol < 5%.

anomalies.name: Pastor-Stambaugh liquidity beta
anomalies.description: Monthly excess return (ret -rf) regressed on innovations in liquidity from Pastor's website (\url{https://faculty.chicagobooth.edu/lubos.pastor/research/liq_data_1962_2018.txt}). Use 60 month rolling window regression, and require at least 36 non-missing observations.

anomalies.name: Momentum and LT Reversal
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if firm is in the highest Mom6m quintile and the lowest Mom36m quintile, and equal to 0 if firm is in the lowest Mom6m quintile and the highest Mom36m quintile. Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Size
anomalies.description: Log of monthly market value of equity (abs(prc)*shrout)).

anomalies.name: Suppliers momentum
anomalies.description: We download BEA Make-Use Tables, match to Compustat by NAICS assuming 5 year lag, compute returns within BEA 70 industries.  Then match each industry-year to matched-industry weights corresponding to IO tables as follows: for supplier mom, industry comes from cols of Use table, matched industries from the rows.  For customer mom: industry from rows of make table, matched industries from cols.  Weights exclude own-industry entries.  For each industry-month, average returns of matched industries, weighted using IO tables.  Sort industries into deciles based on matched returns, assign firm-months to industry deciles, Finally, long stocks in deciles 8-10 and short decile 1. Drop pre-1986 due to NAICS availability.

anomalies.name: Change in Net Working Capital
anomalies.description: Twelve-month change in net working capital. Net working capital is ( (act - che) - (lct - dlc) )/at

anomalies.name: Volume Variance
anomalies.description: Rolling standard deviation of monthly trading volume (vol) over the past 36 months (require at least 24 observations). Include only NYSE stocks.

anomalies.name: Realized (Total) Volatility
anomalies.description: Standard deviation of residuals from CAPM regressions using the past month of daily data.  Value weighted

anomalies.name: Operating leverage
anomalies.description: Sum of administrative expenses (xsga) and cost of goods sold (cogs), scaled by total assets (at).  Use xsga = 0 if xsga is missing.

anomalies.name: Long-term EPS forecast
anomalies.description: Lag long-term earnings forecast (fgr5yr) by 6 months.   Then keep only June observations, and fill in missing with most recent obs.  Exclude if book equity (ceq), net income (ib), deferred taxes (txdi), dividends (dvp), revenue (sale) or depreciation (dp) is missing.  Keep only

anomalies.name: Analyst Optimism
anomalies.description: AnalystValue (defined above) minus IntrinsicValue (defined above), divided by abs(IntrinsicValue).

anomalies.name: Sales growth over inventory growth
anomalies.description: Percentage growth in sales (sale) relative to average sales of t-1 and t-2, minus percentage growth in inventory (invt) relative to average inventory of t-1 and t-2. Both growth terms are calculated relative to t-1 only if t-2 is missing.

anomalies.name: Idiosyncratic risk (AHT)
anomalies.description: Standard deviation of residuals from CAPM regressions using the past year of daily data. Require at least 100 non-missing observations.

anomalies.name: Net Operating Assets
anomalies.description: Difference between operating assets and operating liabilities, scaled by lagged total assets. Operating assets are total assets (at) minus cash- and short-term investments (che), operating liabilities are total assets minus long-term debt (dltt), minority interest (mib), deferred charges (dc) and book equity (ceq).

anomalies.name: Citations to RD expenses
anomalies.description: Drop obs before 1975.  Set expenses for research and development (xrd) and number of citations (ncit)  to 0 if missing. Calculate Citations to RD as sum of citations over previous 5 years divided by sum of xrd over years $t-3, \ldots, \t-7$.  Drop if denominator = 0,  2 years or less in Compustat, sic in 6000s, ceq < 0.  Double independent sort using (a) size NYSE median (b) terciles of Citations to RD.  Long if in small size, highest tercile of Citations to RD, short if in small size, smallest tercile.

anomalies.name: Spinoffs
anomalies.description: Spinoffs are identified as all observations in the CRSP acquisition file with valid acperm entry. Spinoff is a binary variable equal to 1 if a firm is identified in the CRSP Acquisition data and if it has at most two years of history in the CRSP stock return data. Spinoff is equal to 0 otherwise.

anomalies.name: Bid-ask spread
anomalies.description: Effective bid ask spread based on Corwin-Schulz scaled by stock price.

anomalies.name: Share turnover volatility
anomalies.description: Standard deviation of turnover (vol/shrout) over the past 36 months.

anomalies.name: Predicted Analyst forecast error
anomalies.description: The fitted value from cross-sectional regressions of analyst earnings' forecast errors on cross-sectional rankings of 5-year sales growth, book-to-market, AOP, and analyst long term growth.  See code for details.

anomalies.name: Cash-flow  to price variance
anomalies.description: Rolling variance of (ib+dp)/mve\_c over the past 60 months (minimum 24 months data required).

anomalies.name: Return seasonality years 2 to 5
anomalies.description: Average return in the same month over the preceding 2-5 years.

anomalies.name: Book leverage (annual)
anomalies.description: Total assets (at) divided by book value of equity plus deferred taxes (txditc) and preferred stock. Equity is shareholder equity (seq) if available, or book equity (ceq) plus preferred stock (pstk, if missing pstkrv, if missing pstkl), or total assets minus total liabilities (lt).

anomalies.name: Total accruals
anomalies.description: Before 1988: Change in net working capital ((act - che) - (lct - dlc)) plus change in net noncurrent assets ( (at - act - ivao) - (lt - dlc - dltt)) plus change in net financial assets ( (ivst + ivao - (dltt + dlc + pstk)). Starting in 1988: net income (ni) minus total, operating and investment cashflows (oancf, ivncf, fincf) plus stock sales minus repurchases and dividends (sstk, prstkc, dv)). Scaled by lagged total assets (at). Replace missings in ivao, ivst, dltt, dlc, pstk sstk, prstkc, dv with 0.

anomalies.name: Sin Stock (selection criteria)
anomalies.description: Using Compustat Segment data, sinAlgo is defined as a binary variable equal to 1 if at least one segment of a firm is listed as being in at least one of the following industries: sic $\geq$ 2100 & sic $\leq$ 2199, sic $\geq$2080 & sic $\leq$ 2085, NAICS in \{7132, 71312, 713210, 71329, 713290, 72112, 721120\}. As in the original paper, we assume that the sin stock indicator applies to the entire history and future of the identified firm. sinAlgo is equal to 0 if the firm is not identified in the CS Segment data as a sin stock and if the firm is in one of the following industries: (sic $\geq$ 2000 & sic $\leq$ 2046) OR (sic $\geq$ 2050 & sic $\leq$ 2063) OR (sic $\geq$ 2070 & sic $\leq$ 2079) OR (sic $\geq$ 2090 & sic $\leq$ 2092) OR (sic $\geq$ 2095 & sic $\leq$ 2099) OR (sic $\geq$ 2064 & sic $\leq$ 2068) OR (sic $\geq$ 2086 & sic $\leq$ 2087) OR (sic $\geq$  920 & sic $\leq$  999) OR (sic $\geq$ 3650 & sic $\leq$ 3652) OR sic == 3732 OR  (sic $\geq$ 3931 & sic $\leq$ 3932) OR (sic $\geq$ 3940 & sic $\leq$ 3949) OR  (sic $\geq$ 7800 & sic $\leq$ 7833) OR (sic $\geq$ 7840 & sic $\leq$ 7841) OR (sic $\geq$ 7900 & sic $\leq$ 7911) OR (sic $\geq$ 7920 & sic $\leq$ 7933) OR (sic $\geq$ 7940 & sic $\leq$ 7949) OR sic $==$ 7980 OR (sic $\geq$ 7990 & sic $\leq$ 7999)

anomalies.name: Leverage component of BM
anomalies.description: BP - EBM, where BP = (ceq + tstkp - dvpa)/(shrout*abs(prc)), and EBM is defined above. Exclude if price less than 5.

anomalies.name: Unexpected R&D increase
anomalies.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if: R&D (xrd) scaled by revenue (revt) is positive, R&D scaled by total assets (at) is positive, annual R&D growth is greater than 5%, annual growth in R&D over total assets is greater than 5%. SurpriseRD is 0 otherwise.

anomalies.name: Cash to assets
anomalies.description: Ratio of quarterly cash and short-term investments (cheq) and total assets (atq).

anomalies.name: Off season reversal years 11 to 15
anomalies.description: Average return in other months over the preceding 11-15 years.

anomalies.name: Growth in long term operating assets
anomalies.long_description: Growth in long term operating assets
anomalies.description: Annual growth in net operating assets, minus accruals. Net operating assets are (rect + invt + ppent + aco + intan + ao- ap- lco- lo) / at. Accruals are ( rect-l12.rect + invt - l12.invt + aco - l12.aco - (ap - l12.ap + lco - l12.lco) - dp ) / ((at + l12.at)/2)

anomalies.name: Frazzini-Pedersen Beta
anomalies.description: Using daily data, call tempRi the sum of today's return and the past 2 days, call tempRm the sum of today's mkt return and the past 2 days mkt return.  Regress return on tempRi and tempRm using past 5 years of data, with a minimum of 3 years.  BetaFP is the square root of the r square from this regression times the ratio of the idiosyncratic stock vol and the market vol.

anomalies.name: Price delay SE adjusted
anomalies.description: Each July regress daily stock return (ret) on market return (mktrf) in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ using observations from July 1 of the previous year to June 30 of the current year.  Trim the highest and lowest 1% of estimated coefficients, standard errors, and t-stats. Define PriceDelayTstat as the ratio of [1*tstat on mktrf$_t-1$ + 2*tstat on mktrf$_t-2$ + 3*tstat on mktrf$_t-3$ + 4*tstat on mktrf$_t-4$], and [tstat on mktrf$_t$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-1$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-2$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-3$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-4$].   Finally winsor the extreme 10 and 90 percentiles each month.

anomalies.name: Price delay coeff
anomalies.description: Each July regress daily stock return (ret) on market return (mktrf) in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ with observations over the previous year. Define PriceDelaySlope as the ratio of ]1*beta on mktrf$_t-1$ + 2*beta on mktrf$_t-2$ + 3*beta on mktrf$_t-3$ + 4*beta on mktrf$_t-4$], and [beta on mktrf$_t$ + beta on mktrf$_t-1$ + beta on mktrf$_t-2$ + beta on mktrf$_t-3$ + beta on mktrf$_t-4$].

anomalies.name: R&D capital-to-assets
anomalies.description: R&D capital to assets is the weighted sum of lagged R&D expenditures scaled by the assets (at). We replace xrd with 0 if xrd is missing and compute the numerator as $xrd_t + .8 xrd_{t-1}+ .6xrd_{t-2} + .4 xrd_{t-3} + .2 xrd_{t-4}$. Replace RDcap with missing before  1980 or if firm is in upper two thirds of market cap (shrout*abs(prc)) distribution in a month.

anomalies.name: Change in Net Noncurrent Op Assets
anomalies.long_description: Change in Net Noncurrent Op Assets
anomalies.description: Twelve-month change in noncurrent operating assets. Noncurrent operating assets is ( (at - act - ivao) - (lt - dlc - dltt) )/at.

anomalies.name: Firm age based on CRSP
anomalies.description: Months since start of CRSP coverage.

anomalies.name: Abnormal Accruals
anomalies.description: Define Accruals as net income (ib) minus operating cash flow (oancf), divided by average total assets (at) for years t-1 and t. If oancf is missing, replace operating cash flow with funds from operations (fopt) minus the annual change in total current assets (act) plus the annual change in cash and short-term investments (che) plus the annual change in current liabilities (lct) minus the annual change in debt in current liabilities (dlc). For each year t and 2-digit sic code, regress Accruals on: the inverse of average total assets for year t-1, the change in revenue (sale) from year t-1 to t divided by total assets for t-1, propery plant and equipment (ppegt) divided by total assets for t-1.  AbnormalAccrual is the residual from this cross-sectional regression.  See code for more details.

anomalies.name: Real dirty surplus
anomalies.description: Define Dirty Surplus as annual change in marketable securities adjustment msa plus annual change in retained earnings adjustment (recta) + .65 times the annual change in min(Unrecognized prior service cost (pcupsu) - Pension additional minimum liability (paddml),0). Real dirty surplus is the annual change in book equity (ceq) minus dirty surplus minus (net income (ni) minus dividends preferred (dvp)) + dividends (divamt) - end-of-fiscal-year-stock-price (prcc\_f)*annual change in common shares outstanding (csho).

anomalies.name: Sales growth over overhead growth
anomalies.description: GrSaleToGrOverHead = Percentage growth in sales (sale) relative to average sales of t-1 and t-2, minus percentage growth in administrative expenses (xsga) relative to average administrative expenses of t-1 and t-2. Both growth terms are calculated relative to t-1 only if t-2 is missing.

anomalies.name: Price delay r square
anomalies.description: Each July regress stock return on day $t$ on market return in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ using observations from July 1 of the previous year to June 30 of the current year.  Then regress again with no market return lags.  PriceDelay Rsq = 1 - [Rsq from second regression]/[Rsq from first regression]

anomalies.name: Brand capital investment
anomalies.description: Advertising expenses (xad) divided by BrandCapital. Brand capital is computed by the perpetual inventory method. In the first year, brand capital is advertising expense divided by (.5 + .1). In subsequent years, we let brand capital depreciate with a rate of .5 and add current advertising expenses. Brand capital is scaled by total assets (at). Set to missing if advertising expense is missing.  Drop if 1st digit of sic = 4 or 6, and keep only Dec fiscal year ends.

anomalies.name: Option volume to average
anomalies.description: Based off of OptionVolume1.  OptionVolume2 = OptionVolume1 / average of OptionVolume1 from months t-6 to t-1.

anomalies.name: Pension Funding Status
anomalies.description: FR = (FVPA - PBO), scaled by market value of equity. FVPA is pbnaa from 1980 to 1986, pplao + pplao from 1987 to 1997, and pplao after 1997. PBO is pbnvv from 1980 to 1986, pbpro + pbpru from 1987 to 1997, and pbpro after 1997. Exclude if price less than 5 or  shrcd > 11.

anomalies.name: Order backlog
anomalies.description: Order backlog (ob) divided by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t. Exclude if order backlog is 0.

anomalies.name: Industry concentration (sales)
anomalies.description: Three-year rolling average of the three digit industry Herfindahl index based on firm revenue (sale). Exclude regulated industries (4011, 4210, 4213 & year $\leq$ 1980; 4512 & year $\leq$ 1978, 4812, 4813 & year $\leq$ 1982, 4900-4999 in any year)

anomalies.name: Industry concentration (equity)
anomalies.description: Three-year rolling average of the three digit industry Herfindahl index based on firm book equity. Exclude regulated industries (4011, 4210, 4213 & year $\leq$ 1980; 4512 & year $\leq$ 1978, 4812, 4813 & year $\leq$ 1982, 4900-4999 in any year)

anomalies.name: Takeover vulnerability
anomalies.description: 24 minus Governance Index (G). Set to missing if G is missing, or if not in the highest quartile of institutional ownership (maxinstown\_perc), or if dual share class.

anomalies.name: Industry concentration (assets)
anomalies.description: Three-year rolling average of the three digit industry Herfindahl index based on firm assets (at). Exclude regulated industries (4011, 4210, 4213 & year $\leq$ 1980; 4512 & year $\leq$ 1978, 4812, 4813 & year $\leq$ 1982, 4900-4999 in any year)

anomalies.name: Governance Index
anomalies.description: Index available from http://faculty.som.yale.edu/andrewmetrick/data.html . The index is only available every 2-3 years for each firm, we replace intermediate missing values with the latest available one.  Value-weighted.

anomalies.name: Patents to RD expenses
anomalies.description: Drop obs before 1975.  Set expenses for research and development (xrd) and number of patents (npat)  to 0 if missing. Calculate Patents to RD as patents in a year divided by $xrd_{t-2} + .8 xrd_{t-3} + .6 xrd_{t-4} + .4xrd_{t-5} + .2 xrd_{t-6}$. Drop if denominator = 0,  2 years or less in Compustat, sic in 6000s, ceq < 0.  Double independent sort using (a) size NYSE median (b) terciles of Patents to RD.  Long if in small size, highest tercile of Patents to RD, short if in small size, smallest tercile.
